LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GateWrongOwner: Choose a standing colonist on this map who owns the source or wears this relic.

LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GateNeedLegacyChoice: Choose your first evolution before selecting a progression node.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GateComplete: All stages of this route are complete.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GatePendingMigration: Legacy progress needs migration. Choose and confirm the new route first.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GateInvalidState: The route has changed. Reopen the atlas to inspect it.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GateBusy: Finish or end the current trial first.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_GateNoMaterials: Not enough prismatic shards or cores to retrain the selected stages.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_DirectHelp: Meet the source and growth requirements, then confirm out of combat. Wait two days between stages.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_RouteHelp: A colony route shares unlocked branch choices. Each colonist inherits stages after meeting source requirements, leaving combat and completing recovery. Effects and cooldowns remain individual. Relics still require their own growth and first-stage materials. Retrain conflicting branches before inheriting; published routes must extend the existing shared branch.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_RouteColonyHelp: The colony progresses along this route together. Economic rewards are paid once for the colony.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_RouteRespecPersonal: This retraining switches you to a personal route. The colony route is kept, and you can choose your own branch after removing nodes.
LanguageData.RHA_StarAtlas030_RefinementHelp: Node descriptions list base values. Refinement scales only the named benefits; upstream node multipliers are not applied again. All mechanics are available on first unlock. Repeat clears raise the multiplier with diminishing returns. Targets, counts, range, costs and cooldowns follow the node's rules.
